related_resources.reason: A complete Lipschitz-graph boundary Harnack proof and Hölder quotient statement.
The homogeneous theorem and its limitations for forced elliptic equations.
Difference between interior and boundary Harnack estimates.
Connection to positive Green functions and boundary influence.

authorship.scope: Original spoken lecture and non-spoken mathematical companion for the boundary-capacity-Wiener bridge; 39 existing manuscripts retained unchanged.

prerequisites.reason: Interior Harnack inequality and harmonic positivity.
Hopf boundary growth and geometric restrictions.
Harmonic measure and Dirichlet Green function.

recommended.reason: Understand how the geometric size of a boundary set can be measured variationally.

background: Positive harmonic functions, ordinary Harnack estimates, planar polar coordinates and Lipschitz graphs; the flat example and wedge calculation are worked out.
readiness_checks: Differentiate y(1+x/4) to prove harmonicity and check its quotient with y.

description: Examines boundary Harnack comparison, positive harmonic functions, flat and corner models, and the relationship with harmonic measure.
